The return policy states that products can be returned if they are undamaged and complete. You are allowed to try the product, but items with signs of use are not accepted. Returns must be requested within 30 days from the delivery date. Some products cannot be returned, including opened in-ear headphones, personal care products, opened software packages, and custom-made products.

I will check the details of your order KS-1001 to see if it qualifies for a return.
